name: Kitano Honoka
source:
Hobbies: Gardening
Likes: Vegetables devoid of pesticides
Dislikes: Retort food

A girl born in Touhoku who has a pure personality. She easily believes in people and tends to take their jokes seriously, and is quite clumsy as well. Honoka rarely talks with men, and even talking with [url=/c54699]Seita[/url] annoys her to no end. Honoka is also a member of [url=/c55128]Yuki's[/url] all-girls' community "Yuri".
